fields.factual_errors: none found - all four checkable facts (holdout=sealed, unseal=owner-gated (ej), one_shot=true, never opened) are verbatim matches against eval/protocol.json and eval/README.md; the registry claims are a provenance gap, not a demonstrated error.
fields.other_attacks: self-contradiction between claimed non-authority and a directive 5-item checklist; the currency framing assumes banked value that an unspendable coin may not have; the section 1 fact table mixes eval/-sourced facts with registry-sourced claims that are unverifiable from the artifacts under review; section 6 self-scoring flagged the need for an adversarial review and then submitted without one.
fields.residual_concern: require the power-argument feasibility check to be attempted immediately and independently of the other three preconditions, with an owner and a review date; and separate registry-sourced claims from eval/-sourced claims in the section 1 table.
fields.strongest_attack: The wait recommendation has no forcing function. Precondition 4 (the power argument) is the one that decides whether the hold-out can ever answer anything, and the document defers it indefinitely with no owner, no deadline and no revisit trigger, while relegating retirement to a closing aside. That lets 'hold sealed pending preconditions' decay into 'sealed forever' by inertia rather than by anyone deciding it on purpose.
